about_the_game:
Brewconomy is a cozy yet challenging production-chain management game where you turn raw materials into a thriving business empire.
Start small with a single workshop and grow into a network of bustling industries — balancing production, workers, and trade routes.
Easy to learn but rewarding to master, every decision shapes the success and scale of your company.

Gather & Craft

Produce raw materials, refine them into goods, and combine products into more complex creations.
Watch your supply chains come alive as production lines start running efficiently and profits begin to rise.

Build & Automate

Buy or rent buildings, set up farms, shops, mines, and factories.
Automate workflows to reduce micromanagement — or stay hands-on and fine-tune every part of your business operation.

Grow Your Business

Expand from a small family venture into a fully developed industrial company.
Unlock new sectors, technologies, and production tiers to increase efficiency and scale your operations.

Trade & Prosper

Prices fluctuate with supply and demand.
Specialize in key products, trade with other regions, and dominate the market through smart planning and timing.

Sandbox Experience

Play freely at your own pace, experimenting with layouts, production chains, and trade networks.
Focus on optimization, growth, and efficiency — with no pressure or mandatory objectives.

Key Features

Production Chains – transform raw materials into valuable goods.
Business Expansion – grow from a family workshop into a full industrial company.
Automation – optimize supply lines and reduce repetitive tasks.
Dynamic Seasons & Weather – adapt your production to changing conditions.
Market Simulation – trade, specialize, and react to shifting prices.
Sandbox Mode – play freely and build your ideal economic network.

Shape your business, your way.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows
  • Processor: x86_32
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Brewconomy is a relaxing yet challenging builder about farming, crafting, and trade. Begin with a small family workshop and grow into a thriving company. Automate production chains, expand industries, and balance resources to master your own economy.

English*, French, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese
